official_finding.caveat: Nobody adjudicated this one: five infrastructure candidates, one dark vessel, zero vessel candidates, and a model class that says 'vessel' anyway, with no human review. A claim that Cerulean flags this area as a known natural-seep zone could not be substantiated against their published AOI layers (EEZ, IHO Sea Areas, MPA, user-generated) -- there is no seep layer in their schema, and this slick is classed VESSEL, not NATURAL.

assessment.explanation: UDGAM names three vessel candidates at LOW confidence (weight_live 0.35 -- the score rests on 2 of 7 measurable components, all gap and slowdown structurally unmeasurable at GFW's hourly sampling). The reference finding is a multi-source case with zero vessel candidates and both infrastructure and a dark vessel plausible; UDGAM's infrastructure and dark-vessel modules produced no candidates here because neither has a declared fixed-source target for this case and no radar contact was matched against it. The vessel ranking UDGAM does produce is not contradicted by the reference -- it simply cannot be corroborated by it either, since the reference names no vessel at all.
assessment.what_would_have_helped: A declared infrastructure candidate for this coastline (as Huntington's pipeline should have been) and a radar-contact cross-check run against this scene, the same machinery that surfaced the Gulf of Alaska dark vessel.
